This channel is created by Dr.Viram Varshney
A famous and renowned Veterinary surgeon in Aligarh.The main Motto of this channel is to spread awareness among pet owner ,Farmers,and all those who loves animals.As you know there are many quacks running clinic in market/villages/towns ,sometime owner get confused where to take their animals for right treatment.In this channel you will find videos that contains initial condition of animals suffering from critical problem to till recovery so that any animal owner can see step by step recovery..
